levels.label: 首页
levels.purpose: 先给出今天要处理的真实行动，再显示进度与所选模块入口
levels.primary_action_rule: exactly one primary action; it opens or completes the most relevant selected-scope work

levels.label: 模块
levels.purpose: 完成一个已确认模块的内置工作和自有记录操作
levels.primary_action_rule: the module's real work action precedes history, analytics and settings

levels.label: 详情
levels.purpose: 聚焦当前模块中的一个记录、资料、练习、阶段对象或回顾条目
levels.primary_action_rule: only the active object's next valid action is primary
levels.runtime_note: generic runtime provides one independent selected-object detail hash view with an owning-module return; child runtime keeps its existing focused practice detail

levels.label: 成人设置
levels.purpose: 承载本地数据、导入导出、危险操作、来源边界以及成人专属规则
levels.primary_action_rule: safe backup precedes import, clear, external handoff and rule changes
levels.runtime_note: data-tools is explicitly bound as adult_settings and contains selected-scope backup, confirmed import, immediate undo, confirmed clear, local workspace snapshots and boundary disclosure

navigation_edges.condition: object belongs to the active selected module
adult context is active when the scene distinguishes child and adult modes
settings never bypass the owning selected module

hierarchy.active_view_rule: exactly one home, module, detail or adult-settings work view is active; navigation chrome is the only persistent parallel surface

first_screen_slots.primary_surface: surface.today-action or the selected primary module's real action
first_screen_slots.progress: traceable progress from selected local state
first_screen_slots.supporting_panel: at most one secondary context panel

mappings.compatibility_rule: existing hashes, data-view-id values, legacy surface types and stored record shapes remain valid; stable layout and surface IDs are additive until runtime integration is separately authorized

selection_source: approved product capabilities with mode in_page
atomic capabilities reachable from the selected scene and module path
selected_scope_visibility.compile_rule: derive a minimal candidate payload from the approved selected path before rendering; do not render the full catalog and hide it with CSS

invariants.rule: navigation contains home, every selected module exactly once and the relevant local-data or adult-settings entry. Richness is each selected room having work, not fewer rooms
invariants.negative_rule: an unselected module has no navigation entry; hiding a selected module from peer navigation to look clean is a failure

invariants.rule: module and detail DOM nodes are created only for selected modules and selected content items
invariants.negative_rule: hidden unselected DOM is a failure

invariants.rule: runtime MODULES, initial local state and import normalization contain selected module IDs only
invariants.negative_rule: shipping unselected module data in script or storage defaults is a failure

invariants.rule: the raw capability graph, atom registry and catalog are governance inputs and are not user-visible or serialized as a page directory
invariants.negative_rule: minimal selected IDs used for deterministic bindings must not expose the raw graph or its descriptions

invariants.rule: candidate copy, DOM, export and error messages never expose build directory, staging directory, repository path or host filesystem path
invariants.negative_rule: a local absolute path or directory listing in the candidate is a failure

invariants.rule: surface IDs, capability IDs, atom IDs, module IDs, starter and internal action or question type names stay out of user-visible copy
invariants.negative_rule: machine identifiers may exist only in non-visible binding attributes or governance receipts

invariants.rule: adult settings and data operations enumerate and mutate only selected module state
invariants.negative_rule: settings cannot become a back door to optional or catalog-only modules

viewports.navigation: fixed or sticky vertically scrollable left rail with colored emoji and visible short labels for home, all selected modules and data entry
viewports.composition: single main content column; the left rail must not cover or truncate the content
viewports.primary_work: today action or current module action appears in the first scroll viewport
viewports.forms: single column; inputs use at least 16px text and semantic input modes
viewports.detail: one active item or record flow, not a reduced desktop table or board

viewports.navigation: 96-112px vertically scrollable left rail with colored emoji and visible concise labels
viewports.composition: main work uses one or two columns; navigation and active work remain simultaneously legible
viewports.primary_work: real work remains before metrics, history and secondary panels
viewports.forms: one or two columns according to field length; control order remains linear
viewports.detail: active detail may sit beside context only when it retains a single logical reading order
viewports.runtime_binding: 760-899px uses a 104px vertically scrollable labeled rail; 900px and above switches to the desktop identity sidebar

viewports.navigation: 180-220px identity sidebar with colored emoji and visible text
viewports.composition: identity sidebar plus main work surface and at most one supporting column
viewports.primary_work: main action occupies the dominant area; analytics and history remain secondary
viewports.forms: one or two columns with labels adjacent in reading order; record actions stay with their record
viewports.detail: detail and supporting context may be adjacent but only one detail is active

touch: all primary, destructive, answer, navigation and record controls have a minimum 44 by 44px target on touch viewports
controls do not require hover and labels remain visible
numeric practice uses an in-page keypad where the workflow requires the system keyboard not to displace content
gesture is never the only way to move, archive, reveal, undo or navigate
keyboard: tab order follows navigation, active heading, primary work, secondary work and recovery controls
Enter activates links and primary form submission; Space activates buttons and toggles according to native semantics
focus is visibly styled on every interactive element
hash or view navigation moves focus to the active view heading or first meaningful action
Escape closes a transient dialog or cancellation state without discarding persisted truth
no keyboard trap exists in rail, practice, detail, import or confirmation flows
pointer: click targets use the same accessible operation as keyboard activation
drag may enhance a stage board but a labeled move control remains available
motion: celebration and shake feedback never cover the active controls
transient animation is cleared before the next item
prefers-reduced-motion removes nonessential motion without removing feedback text
dangerous_actions: delete, clear, import replacement, irreversible constraint and external handoff require an explicit confirmation appropriate to their impact
import supports immediate undo after successful normalization
external publish, sync, message, payment or account actions remain manual handoff or unsupported

landmarks_and_headings: navigation and active main work use distinct landmarks
each active view has one programmatically determinable primary heading
heading order does not skip solely for visual sizing
names_and_states: every control has a non-empty accessible name
selected navigation, expanded content, pressed answer and disabled reason expose programmatic state
emoji used only as decoration is aria-hidden; semantic meaning also appears in text
status, overdue, error, success and stage are never conveyed by color alone
focus: focus indicator remains visible at 200 percent zoom and against all template backgrounds
view changes and errors move or retain focus predictably
hidden and unselected surfaces cannot receive focus
text_and_contrast: body and input text is at least 16px on mobile
text and controls meet AA contrast; decorative category color is not sole meaning
content supports 200 percent zoom and reflow without two-dimensional scrolling
feedback: save, import, answer and recovery status uses a polite live region
blocking validation identifies the field or operation and gives a recovery action
charts, visual questions and progress graphics have equivalent text or accessible names

storage_write_failure.user_state: all entered fields and the last persisted truth remain unchanged
storage_write_failure.message: state that saving failed and offer retry or export
storage_write_failure.forbidden: clearing the form, optimistic success or partial truth mutation

invalid_or_unknown_route.user_state: return to home without creating an unselected surface
invalid_or_unknown_route.message: use a quiet recoverable navigation state unless user action is required
invalid_or_unknown_route.forbidden: falling through to the full catalog or first optional module

import_failure.user_state: existing local data remains intact and the file input is reset for retry
import_failure.message: identify size, format, identity or record-limit failure without exposing a host path
import_failure.forbidden: partial replacement, unsafe external IDs or silent unknown-field loss

import_success.user_state: normalized selected-module state is persisted and the prior state is available for immediate undo
import_success.message: announce completion, unknown-field preservation and undo availability

reload_restore.user_state: active selected view and persisted module data restore when safe; invalid detail returns to its owning module or home
reload_restore.message: announce only a recovery failure that requires action
reload_restore.forbidden: reconstructing state from wall clock, fabricated defaults or a stale full catalog

external_capability_failure.user_state: retain local input and show cached or declared fallback only when the capability contract permits it
external_capability_failure.message: state that the external result is unavailable and what remains local
external_capability_failure.forbidden: fabricating a live response, silently using stale data or exposing a secret

destructive_action.user_state: no mutation before confirmation; after success provide undo when the policy declares it reversible
destructive_action.message: name the exact selected-scope data affected
destructive_action.forbidden: broad confirmation that includes unselected modules or hidden data

acceptance.check: one hierarchy work view is visible and focusable at a time; navigation chrome may persist
navigation, DOM, script payload, initial storage and export contain no unselected module or catalog-only content
acceptance.evidence: approved selection versus candidate serialization diff

acceptance.check: raw capability graph, atom registry, repository path, build directory and staging directory are absent from visible copy and exported user data
mobile 390x844, tablet 768x1024 and desktop 1280x900 each have no horizontal overflow, visible labeled navigation and all selected entries reachable
complete primary work, detail, save, recovery and navigation paths succeed by touch/pointer and keyboard without a trap
visible controls have names, focus indicators, textual state and AA contrast; hidden surfaces are not focusable
acceptance.evidence: automated scan plus keyboard and zoom inspection

acceptance.check: forced storage failure preserves every required and optional field plus the previous persisted state
acceptance.evidence: full-form failure injection and field-by-field comparison

acceptance.check: confirmed import, invalid import, unknown-field preservation, immediate undo and clear confirmation affect selected state only
acceptance.evidence: positive and negative browser recovery paths

acceptance.check: all four declared first-screen slots exist, exactly one primary action is present and module directories are not duplicated
acceptance.evidence: renderer structure fingerprint and first-viewport inspection

current_runtime_evidence: builder enforces four first-screen slots and a single active hash view
builder renders selected in-page modules plus local data tools
browser collector uses canonical mobile 390x844, tablet 768x1024 and desktop 1280x900 evidence for the generic renderer
browser collector checks overflow, navigation visibility, focus, touch controls, reload, import and forced storage failure
maturity_notes: home and module mappings are executable_ready
home, module, independent selected-object detail and adult_settings mappings are executable_ready
mobile, 104px compact-rail tablet and desktop are executable_ready at the current evidence boundary
this contract does not claim release_ready, packaged, host-synced, deployed, published or long-term effective
known_gaps: layout IDs are additive DOM bindings and stay out of visible copy
generic detail summarizes the selected object and returns to its owner; domain-specific rich editors remain inside module views
adult_settings is local-only and does not imply accounts, cloud sync or multi-user authorization
selected-only absence is governed by the v0.52 compiler and browser combination receipt
no layout level or viewport is release_ready or backed by long-term real-user evidence
